name: icu4c-78.3
purpose: ICU in the system layer. Its public headers are in the sysroot (plan step R1.2b): System.Globalization.Native, which CoreCLR links on every platform, compiles against them as on Linux and loads ICU's libraries at run time. Its libraries (plan step R4.3), libicuuc, libicui18n and libicudata with the release's prebuilt little-endian data, are built from the same tarball after ICU's own Makefile rules and installed in /usr/lib, so that .NET has culture data (RFC 0015 section 8). ICU4C 78.3, the latest stable release, by the SHA-256 of its source tarball; the common and i18n sources, data/in/icudt78l.dat and the license are extracted.
